inputValue.label: Full Stack Developer
inputValue.summary: Dynamic Full Stack Developer with a proven track record of designing, developing, and maintaining scalable full-stack applications for high-volume eCommerce platforms. Skilled in modern web technologies, including JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js, Next.js, Node.js, and GraphQL. Experienced in integrating multiple platforms into cohesive solutions, optimizing performance, and collaborating with distributed teams to deliver high-quality user experiences. Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to mentoring and knowledge sharing.
